description: This file contains unit tests for the MediaKeySession decryption functionality in a media streaming context, specifically testing the decrypt method under various conditions including success, failure, and error handling.

classes.name: RialtoServerMediaKeySessionDecryptTest
classes.description: A test fixture class for testing the decryption functionality of media key sessions, inheriting from MediaKeySessionTestBase.

methods.name: Success
methods.description: Test that the decrypt method successfully decrypts a buffer when the underlying session returns OK.

methods.name: OcdmSessionFailure
methods.description: Test that the decrypt method returns failure when the underlying session indicates a failure.

methods.name: OnErrorFailure
methods.description: Test that the decrypt method fails if an error is triggered during decryption via onError.
